card.statement:
[<<cite:FRT>>, Theorem 14] The center of $U_{q}(\mathfrak {gl}_m)$ is generated by the following $m+1$ elements

$$c_{mk}=\sum_{\sigma,\sigma'\in S_m}(-q)^{l(\sigma)+l(\sigma')}
l_{\sigma(1),\sigma'(1)}^{+}\cdots l_{\sigma(k),\sigma'(k)}^{+}l_{\sigma(k+1),\sigma'(k+1)}^{-}\cdots l_{\sigma(m),\sigma'(m)}^{-},$$

where $0\leq k \leq m$.
card.label: Theorem 2

paper.title: Irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over $U_{q}(\mathfrak{gl}_n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible subquotients of generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules over Uq(gl(n)) where q different 1 and -1.
